verdict.rationale: Firebase's own docs state FirebaseUI is open source [firebase-docs-39], and the Firebase CLI (firebase-tools) has public source on GitHub [firebase-gh-1], so some client-side components are readable. Nothing shows the core hosted services (Firestore, Auth, Functions backend) are source-available under an open license. missing for 10: open-licensed source for the core Firebase platform/services, explicit license terms for firebase-tools, independent corroboration of the licensing.
